mapper.insert: insert into push_subscription (user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, language_code) values (#{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{languageCode}) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id), p256dh = values(p256dh), auth = values(auth), language_code = values(language_code)
mapper.delete: delete from push_subscription where endpoint = #{endpoint} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select s.id, s.user_id, s.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth, s.language_code from push_subscription s join user_preference p on p.user_id = s.user_id where p.reminder_enabled = true
select id, user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, language_code from push_subscription where user_id = #{userId} order by id asc
